topic: '*' may sit inside a folder name (oss-*)
detail: D-65 says '*' matches one folder name. SP-076 matches each '*'-holding folder name with Go's path.Match, so '~/code/*' and '~/code/oss-*' both work, and '*' never crosses a '/'. '?', '[...]', '{...}', '\', '!' and '**' inside a longer name are refused. If only a whole-name '*' is wanted, the parser can refuse 'oss-*' in one line.
